observations: Multiple stacks of used car tires in a warehouse or shop.
Tires vary in tread depth and tread pattern (all-season and winter/snow).
Tread depth appears to be between 3mm and 5mm on the front tires shown.
Tires are stored in a dusty, outdoor environment.
No brand names or model numbers are legible on the sidewalls in the provided photos.

claims.evidence: No Belgian brand markings or distribution logos are visible in the photos.
Photos show tires with very shallow tread, but no depth gauge or measurement is provided.
The interior of the tires is not shown; patches and bulges cannot be confirmed.
No tire age or manufacture date (DOT code) is visible to confirm the year.

risks.risk: Tires may be expired (over 6 years old) making them unsafe.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: Tread depth may be significantly less than 90% of original.
risks.proof: A photo of a tread depth gauge inserted into the tread.

risks.risk: Tires may have hidden punctures or structural damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the interior of the tires.

proof_requests: Close-up of any brand name or model number on a tire sidewall.
Photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall to confirm the manufacture date.
Photo of a tread depth gauge inserted into the tread.
Video of the inside of the tires to check for patches or bulges.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
